anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Bezeugung des Anfangs des nächsten Abschnittes unsicher.
pass_a_gloss: And we are commanded to slaughter the sheep toward evening, since also at a last hour our true sheep, the Savior, came into the world.
pass_b_english: And we are commanded to slaughter the sheep toward evening, since it was also at the last hour that our true sheep, the Savior, came into the world (Exodus 12:6) (1 John 2:18) (Hebrews 1:2) (1 Corinthians 10:11).
source_text: [Πρὸς ἑσπέραν δὲ κελευόμεθα σφάξαι τὸ πρόβατον, ἐπειδὴ καὶ ἐσχάτῃ ὥρᾳ τὸ ἀληθινὸν ἡμῶν πρόβατον εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἦλθεν ὁ σωτήρ.]
